description_good_justification: The repository README and documentation succinctly describe cordanaLLM/nucleus as the automated Linux kernel forge producing customized, hardened, and hardware-optimized Linux kernel distributions and Debian packages for imago. The description details supported kernel streams, target hardware stacks, and compilation architecture. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/README.md#L35-L47 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/README.md#L80-L90
interact_justification: SUPPORT.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and structured GitHub issue templates explain how users and contributors interact with the project to report issues, submit kernel patches, and ask questions. Inquiries and defect reports are handled via GitHub Discussions and GitHub Issues. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SUPPORT.md#L1-L29 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#L7-L43 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml#L1-L9
contribution_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md documents the complete contribution process, including topic branching, Conventional Commits, local quality gates, and pull request metadata requirements. It outlines the trunk-based workflow and developer verification requirements before submission. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#L7-L43 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#L45-L116
contribution_requirements_justification: Contribution requirements are explicitly detailed in CONTRIBUTING.md, which enforces trunk-based development, versions.json single-source-of-truth, NASA/JPL Power of 10 compliance, and local verification passes. Pull requests must satisfy the automated metadata gate and pass all CI checks including ShellCheck, Ruff, and pytest. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#L11-L19 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#L56-L116 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/AGENTS.md
floss_license_justification: All code and build tooling authored by the project are licensed under the European Union Public Licence v1.2 (EUPL-1.2), an open source copyleft licence. The licence is declared repository-wide via the root LICENSE file and REUSE-compliant metadata. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/LICENSE https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/LICENSES/EUPL-1.2.txt https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/REUSE.toml#L1-L16
floss_license_osi_justification: The project's licence, the European Union Public Licence v1.2 (EUPL-1.2), is officially approved as an open source licence by the Open Source Initiative (OSI). Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/LICENSE https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/LICENSES/EUPL-1.2.txt https://opensource.org/license/eupl-1-2
license_location_justification: The full text of the license is provided in the standard root LICENSE file and under LICENSES/EUPL-1.2.txt in compliance with the REUSE specification. The license is also prominently linked in the README header and detailed in the README license section. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/LICENSE https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/LICENSES/EUPL-1.2.txt https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/README.md#L31 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/README.md#L256-L280
documentation_basics_justification: Basic documentation including project mission, architecture, kernel streams matrix, quickstart installation commands, and local build instructions is provided directly in README.md and the docs/ directory. Step-by-step guides explain how to build, test, and verify kernel artifacts. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/README.md#L39-L196 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/docs/principles.md https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/docs/streams.md
documentation_interface_justification: The external interfaces of the forge—including CLI flags for build scripts, kconfig fragment layering rules, and versions.json manifest schemas—are comprehensively documented. Contractual kernel requirements from downstream consumers (imago and Aegis-OS) are defined via JSON schemas and validated in CI. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/README.md#L80-L196 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/docs/streams.md https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/versions.schema.json
sites_https_justification: All project sites, documentation pages, source repositories, and upstream download endpoints use HTTPS exclusively. Upstream kernel sources and Git repositories configured in versions.json use secure https:// URLs. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/versions.json#L4-L37 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SUPPORT.md#L7-L13 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/README.md#L25-L33
discussion_justification: The project provides public GitHub Discussions as a dedicated community channel for questions, hardware compatibility discussions, and architectural proposals. In addition, GitHub Issues and Pull Requests provide public discussion for defects and changes. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SUPPORT.md#L17-L29 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml#L3-L6
english_justification: All documentation, source code comments, script error messages, issue templates, and commit messages are written and maintained in English. CONTRIBUTING.md explicitly mandates an English register for all contributions and discussions. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#L18-L19 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/README.md https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SECURITY.md https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/AGENTS.md
maintained_justification: The project is actively maintained with frequent commits, continuous integration workflows running against multiple kernel streams, and automated changelog tracking. Kernel stream definitions in versions.json are kept current with upstream Linux releases. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#L1-L35 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/versions.json#L4-L68
repo_public_justification: The version-controlled source repository is publicly readable at standard URLs on GitHub. Anyone can inspect the full commit history, branches, issues, and pull requests. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/README.md#L39-L41
repo_track_justification: The project uses Git to track all code changes, committer identities, timestamps, and commit signatures. The repository ruleset enforces commit signing and linear history on the main branch. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/docs/repository-governance.md#L44-L45 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/rulesets/main.json#L27-L32 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#L133-L136
repo_interim_justification: The Git repository records granular interim development commits and pull requests rather than bulk code dumps or infrequent snapshots. Development proceeds on topic branches with Conventional Commits before merging to main. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#L13-L14 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#L45-L101
repo_distributed_justification: The software is tracked using Git, a widely used distributed version control system that allows full offline inspection of repository history and decentralized collaboration. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#L45-L54
version_unique_justification: Every release of the repository tooling is assigned a unique Semantic Version recorded in VERSION and .release-please-manifest.json and tagged as nucleus-v<X.Y.Z>, while kernel release builds are uniquely identified by their stream and upstream version in versions.json together with the forge revision in the v<version>-<stream>-lusoris<N> release tag. Each release produces distinct git tags and package versions. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/VERSION https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/release-please-config.json#L3-L12 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/versions.json#L8-L69 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#L138-L148
version_semver_justification: The repository adheres to Semantic Versioning (SemVer) 2.0.0 for its repository release tags (nucleus-v<X.Y.Z>) and changelog tracking, as documented in CHANGELOG.md and recorded in VERSION. Release pull requests, version bumps in VERSION, and changelog generation are automated via release-please and verified by scripts/check_tool_release.py. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#L5-L8 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/VERSION https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/release-please-config.json#L3-L12 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#L138-L148 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/scripts/check_tool_release.py#L83-L110
version_tags_justification: Every tooling release is tagged in Git using the pattern nucleus-v<X.Y.Z>, and kernel releases are tagged using v<version>-<stream>-lusoris<N>. These tags mark the exact repository commits used to build released artifacts. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#L138-L148 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SECURITY.md#L64-L75
release_notes_justification: A comprehensive, human-readable record of changes for every release is maintained in CHANGELOG.md following the Keep a Changelog standard. Release entries categorize new features, bug fixes, breaking changes, and linked issues. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#L1-L35 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#L56-L66 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/release-please-config.json#L3-L12
release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly known vulnerability with a CVE has been fixed in any release so far; the repository has no security advisories (https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/security/advisories). Release notes will name CVEs once one exists.
report_process_justification: The project provides a clear process for submitting bug reports via GitHub Issues using structured YAML issue forms. SUPPORT.md and the issue template configuration direct users to the bug report form and specify required diagnostic details. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SUPPORT.md#L23-L28 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml#L1-L9
report_tracker_justification: The project uses GitHub Issues as its issue tracker to track bug reports, feature requests, and technical defects individually. Each issue receives a unique URL, issue number, state, and discussion history. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/issues https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SUPPORT.md#L23-L29
report_responses_justification: The maintainers actively triage and respond to reported issues in GitHub Issues, with incoming reports categorized using repository labels and linked to pull requests. Issues closed with linked fixes demonstrate active response and resolution. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/issues https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#L10-L35
enhancement_responses_justification: Enhancement requests and kernel feature proposals are tracked in GitHub Issues via a dedicated feature request template and discussed openly. Maintainers review and respond to community feature requests to plan kconfig additions and driver support. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/issues https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SUPPORT.md#L28 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml
report_archive_justification: All submitted issues, pull requests, comments, and resolutions are publicly and permanently archived on GitHub Issues. The complete history is accessible to all users without login requirements. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/issues
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: A formal vulnerability reporting process is published in SECURITY.md, providing instructions for reporting security issues confidentially via GitHub Security Advisories. It outlines triage procedures, reproduction SLAs, and coordinated disclosure steps. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SECURITY.md#L22-L36 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SUPPORT.md#L29
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: SECURITY.md explicitly directs security researchers to use private GitHub Security Advisories to ensure vulnerabilities are handled confidentially before disclosure. The policy strictly forbids opening public issues for security vulnerabilities. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SECURITY.md#L22-L30 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml#L7-L9
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability reports have been received in the last 6 months (no repository security advisories). The response process is documented in https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SECURITY.md
build_justification: The repository provides an automated build system driven by GNU Make and shell automation scripts in scripts/build_kernel.sh. Invoking make build-kernel or running scripts directly compiles the kernel from source and produces gated packages. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/Makefile#L167-L173 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/scripts/build_kernel.sh#L1-L25
build_common_tools_justification: The build system is constructed using standard, widely available tools including GNU Make, Bash, Python 3, GCC, Clang, and standard Linux kernel build utilities. These tools are standard across Linux distributions and developer environments. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/Makefile#L1-L35 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/scripts/install-build-toolchain.sh#L20-L36 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/scripts/build_kernel.sh#L64-L66 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/scripts/build_kernel.sh#L161-L165 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#L56-L75
build_floss_tools_justification: All tools required to build, test, and package the software are FLOSS, including GNU Make, GNU Bash, Python, GCC for kernel compilation, Clang/LLVM for the in-tree sched_ext BPF scheduler, dpkg-dev and debhelper for Debian packaging, and Syft for release SBOM generation. No proprietary tools or non-free software are required for compilation. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/scripts/install-build-toolchain.sh#L20-L36 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/scripts/build_kernel.sh#L64-L66 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/scripts/build_kernel.sh#L161-L165 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/scripts/build_sched_ext_scheduler.sh#L114-L118 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/workflows/release-build.yml#L71-L72 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/requirements-test.txt
test_justification: The project includes an extensive automated test suite executed via pytest that verifies build scripts, kconfig fragment survival, workflow integrity, and QEMU boot execution. Continuous integration requires all tests to pass prior to merging any pull request. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/Makefile#L95-L97 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml#L72-L87 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/tree/main/tests
test_invocation_justification: The automated test suite is invoked using standard developer commands, specifically make test and pytest tests/. The tests run hermetically without requiring external credentials or specialized infrastructure. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/Makefile#L95-L97 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#L72-L79
test_most_justification: Automated tests cover all core forge functionality, including 1315 collected unit and integration tests across build scripts, requirement verifiers, kconfig rules, and QEMU boot smoke tests. Test coverage targets scripts and tools to prevent regressions. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/Makefile#L95-L104 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/tree/main/tests https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#L72-L79
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: Continuous integration is implemented via GitHub Actions, executing test and linting suites on every push and pull request targeting the main branch. Pull requests cannot be merged unless all required CI status checks pass. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml#L3-L8 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/workflows/build-matrix.yml#L3-L37 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/rulesets/main.json#L45-L90
test_policy_justification: The project maintains a testing policy in AGENTS.md invariant HISS-15 requiring positive, negative, and boundary tests for every public interface, while CONTRIBUTING.md requires contributors to run make test locally before opening pull requests, and CI enforces the test suite on every pull request. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/AGENTS.md#L35 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#L72-L85 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml#L72-L87
tests_are_added_justification: Git commit history verifies that new features, kconfig modifications, and bug fixes consistently include companion automated tests in tests/. Recent additions such as boot console verification and requirement validation were committed alongside dedicated test modules. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/commit/3e88a1645356a23a9895a7ae830622cdbb15277b https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/commit/11ad0ee77096bf5626078ea96a3aaf983b00dc37 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/commit/677dd401b68363b9ac3a1f2e891e6c1a1e9a0d9a https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/tree/main/tests
tests_documented_added_justification: The requirement to add automated tests for new functionality is documented in the agent operating harness AGENTS.md under invariant HISS-15, while CONTRIBUTING.md and docs/community/contributing.md instruct contributors to run make test locally without explicitly stating the requirement to add new tests for new features. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/AGENTS.md#L35 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#L72-L85 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/docs/community/contributing.md#L72-L88
warnings_justification: The build system enforces strict linter and compiler checks using ShellCheck for shell scripts, Ruff for Python code, Yamllint for YAML files, and actionlint for GitHub Actions workflows. All linters must produce zero warnings for quality gates to pass. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/Makefile#L49-L80 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml#L72-L78
warnings_fixed_justification: The repository mandates that all warnings from static analysis and build tools be resolved immediately. CI pipelines treat any linter warning as a build failure, preventing code with warnings from landing on main. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/Makefile#L49-L80 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml#L72-L78 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#L31-L32
warnings_strict_justification: Documentation builds and static analysis tools enforce strict checks, including mkdocs build --strict, semgrep --error, Ruff multi-rule lint checks (E, W, F, I, B, C4, UP) alongside ruff format --check and shfmt -d, and ShellCheck targeting the Bash dialect (shellcheck -s bash) at its default style severity threshold. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/Makefile#L49-L67 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/Makefile#L118-L120 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/pyproject.toml#L54-L66 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/workflows/security-scans.yml#L80-L85
know_secure_design_justification: The primary developer knows secure design principles (least privilege, fail-safe defaults, input validation, minimal attack surface) and applies them; the security policy and enforced repository checks document this. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SECURITY.md
know_common_errors_justification: The primary developer knows the common vulnerability classes for this kind of software (OWASP Top 10, CWE Top 25) and the methods to counter them; static analysis and dependency scanning run on every change. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SECURITY.md
crypto_published_justification: All cryptographic mechanisms employed by the repository rely exclusively on widely accepted, publicly published algorithms such as SHA-256, SHA-512, RSA-4096, and ECDSA P-256. Cryptographic signatures are generated using Sigstore Cosign and OpenSSL. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SECURITY.md#L39-L63 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/scripts/build_kernel.sh#L276-L281 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/scripts/publish_release.sh
crypto_call_justification: The project does not implement bespoke cryptographic primitives, delegating all hashing, signing, and verification operations to standard implementations including OpenSSL, GnuPG gpgv, and Sigstore Cosign. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/scripts/build_kernel.sh#L276-L287 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/scripts/fetch-kernel-source.sh https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SECURITY.md#L39-L63
crypto_floss_justification: All cryptographic operations are executed using FLOSS implementations, including OpenSSL, GnuPG, and Cosign, with source code licensed under open source licences. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/scripts/build_kernel.sh#L64-L66 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/scripts/fetch-kernel-source.sh#L42 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SECURITY.md#L39-L63
crypto_keylength_justification: Kernel module signing keys generated during builds via scripts/build_kernel.sh use certs/default_x509.genkey, which specifies a 4096-bit RSA key (default_bits = 4096), while release artifact signing uses keyless Cosign with ECDSA P-256 signatures. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/scripts/build_kernel.sh#L276-L281 https://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/torvalds/linux.git/plain/certs/default_x509.genkey?id=v7.3-rc7 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SECURITY.md#L39-L63
crypto_working_justification: The repository does not use broken or deprecated cryptographic algorithms such as MD5, SHA-1, DES, or RC4 for integrity verification or code signing. All verification relies on SHA-256, SHA-512, OpenPGP, or Cosign bundles. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SECURITY.md#L39-L63 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/versions.json https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/scripts/fetch-kernel-source.sh
crypto_weaknesses_justification: The project avoids cryptographic algorithms with known weaknesses or reduced security margins, requiring SHA-256 or SHA-512 for checksums and standard RSA-4096 or ECDSA for signatures. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SECURITY.md#L39-L63 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/scripts/build_kernel.sh#L276-L281
crypto_pfs_justification: As an automated kernel build forge and packaging repository, nucleus does not implement network communication protocols or session key exchange, delegating all network transport to HTTPS. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/README.md#L39-L45
crypto_password_storage_justification: The repository produces kernel packages and build artifacts and does not store, verify, or manage user credentials or passwords. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/README.md#L39-L45
crypto_random_justification: All random numbers and cryptographic keys generated during packaging and module signing rely on the operating system's cryptographically secure pseudo-random number generator (/dev/urandom) via OpenSSL. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/scripts/build_kernel.sh#L276-L281
delivery_mitm_justification: All software, dependencies, and upstream kernel tarballs are downloaded exclusively over HTTPS to prevent man-in-the-middle attacks. Published release assets are hosted on HTTPS endpoints on GitHub Releases. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/versions.json#L4-L37 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SECURITY.md#L55-L65 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/README.md#L122-L130
delivery_unsigned_justification: Upstream kernel sources are verified against cryptographic signatures and pinned SHA-256 hashes using GnuPG or git verify-tag before compilation. Furthermore, published release artifacts carry a Cosign signature over SHA256SUMS and SLSA Level 3 provenance. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/scripts/fetch-kernel-source.sh https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SECURITY.md#L39-L75 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/versions.json
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: Continuous automated vulnerability scanning runs in CI via Semgrep SAST and Trivy filesystem CVE scanning (configured to fail on CRITICAL and HIGH severity vulnerabilities with available fixes), and SECURITY.md defines response SLAs (24-hour acknowledgement, 72-hour triage) and regular upstream security maintenance across all four kernel streams. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SECURITY.md#L7-L18 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SECURITY.md#L31-L36 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/workflows/security-scans.yml#L55-L114
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerabilities have been reported or are open; the documented process in https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/SECURITY.md handles critical reports with priority. Advisories: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/security/advisories
no_leaked_credentials_justification: The repository enforces invariant HISS-12 (zero credentials in Git history) and runs Gitleaks in CI on every push and pull request to scan the entire git history. In addition, tests/test_security_privacy.py verifies that no private IP addresses or local workstation paths are committed. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.gitleaks.toml https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/workflows/security-scans.yml#L115-L150 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/tests/test_security_privacy.py
static_analysis_justification: Static analysis is performed automatically using GitHub CodeQL, Semgrep SAST, ShellCheck, and Ruff across Python code, shell scripts, and GitHub Actions workflows. All static analysis checks are enforced in continuous integration. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml#L1-L64 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/workflows/security-scans.yml#L55-L85 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/Makefile#L49-L80
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL is configured with the security-and-quality query suite and Semgrep runs automated security rule sets to detect common software flaws, injection risks, and unsafe script patterns. Findings block PR merging. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml#L55-L60 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/workflows/security-scans.yml#L55-L85
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Security defects and warnings discovered by static analysis tools are systematically resolved prior to merging changes into the main branch. Pull request gates require all security scans and linters to report success. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#L31-L32 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/workflows/security-scans.yml#L157-L209
static_analysis_often_justification: Static analysis runs automatically on every pull request, on every push to main, and on a weekly scheduled cron in GitHub Actions. Developers also run linter gates locally via make lint prior to pushing. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml#L3-L10 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/workflows/security-scans.yml#L3-L10 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/Makefile#L49-L80
dynamic_analysis_justification: Dynamic analysis is performed by executing automated test suites via pytest, fuzzing the requirement parser with Atheris, and booting compiled kernels in virtualized environments under QEMU via scripts/boot_smoke.py. These tests dynamically verify kernel initialization banners and userspace handoff. Evidence: https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/scripts/boot_smoke.py#L1-L32 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/workflows/build-matrix.yml#L237-L280 https://github.com/cordanaLLM/nucleus/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml#L72-L98
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The build forge automation, configuration tools, and test suites are authored entirely in memory-safe languages (Python and Bash) and contain no forge-written C or C++ application code. dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Any dynamic test failure, Atheris fuzzing crash, or QEMU kernel boot error halts CI execution immediately and blocks merging the associated pull request through the required status checks until resolved.
